mentions.name: CyberStory
mentions.description: An interactive fiction platform that blends AI storytelling with generated images, video, and text-to-speech, offering user choices at the end of each story page. It features AI-driven historical fiction adventures across time periods, alternate histories, romance, and more, and users can also build out their own stories.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building out an interactive fiction platform which blends AI storytelling, images, video, and TTS with user choices at the end of each page in the story.
